title.narrative: Trimmu and Panjnad Barrages Improvement Project

description.narrative: 1. Trimmu and Panjnad Barrages Project (TPBP) will rehabilitate and upgrade the Trimmu and Panjnad barrages on the Chenab River, which supply irrigation water to 1.74 million ha through six main canals. The project will (i) rehabilitate and upgrade the two barrages, and (ii) build institutional capacity in flood risk management. Trimmu barrage is located downstream of the confluence of Jhelum and Chenab rivers. Its flood passing capacity (FPC) is reduced from originally 18,265 cubic meters per second (m3s-1) to 12,743 m3s-1. The project will enhance the FPC to 23,220 m3s-1. Panjnad barrage is located downstream of confluence point of Sutlej and Chenab rivers. The project will enhance the barrage's FPC originally, from 19,822 m3s-1 to 24,495 m3s-1.

Loan 3159: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 09 Aug 2024
Loan 3160: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 09 Aug 2024
Progress Toward Outcome: The work on project outputs is going well to achieve the project the outcome. The project is on-track
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Mar 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/47235/47235-001-apfs-en_7.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | May 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/47235/47235-001-iee-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Apr 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/47235/47235-001-smr-en_1.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: The project work is progressing at good pace. Details of project outputs and their progress status is mentioned below.
Output1.Rehabilitated and upgraded Trimmu barrage
Contract Awarded in Nov 2015. Civil Work Progress is 60.5%. 51 gates of main barrage and 15 gates of canal head regulators have been replaced.
Output2. Rehabilitated and upgraded Panjnad barrage.
Contract Awarded in March 2018, contractor commenced work in July 2018 and project work will start with full swing in October 2018.
Output3. Improved capacities of the communities and PID.
Government girls Primary school identified in Canal Colony which will be upgraded to Middle school. MOU has been signed with TEVTA Lahore for training of 50 women. O&M Manual will be finalized at completion.
13 Engineers trained in IHE Delft.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/47235-001/main#project-tenders
